# Lab 7.1: Tour Pipelines & Connections

## What We Are Going to Do
Open the Pipelines & Connections page, opt in to the unified view, and find your transfers, scheduled queries and connections in one place.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create the module dataset.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab07</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Open the page.** In BigQuery click **Pipelines and connections**. If you see the **Unified pipelines and connections** banner, click **Opt-in**. The old **Data transfers**, **Scheduled queries** and **Scheduling** pages are replaced by this one page.

3. **[Console] Explore the tabs.**
   - **Create**: guided cards to load data, schedule tasks and create connections.
   - **Pipelines**: every scheduled query, transfer, notebook schedule and pipeline, with status and run history.
   - **Connections**: external connections such as `us.lab_conn` from Lab 5.8.

4. **[CLI] List the same objects from Cloud Shell.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq ls --transfer_config --transfer_location=us
bq ls --connection --project_id=$PROJECT_ID --location=US</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Opt out (optional).** Click **Opt-out** in the banner if you want the old pages. You can opt in again any time.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| One page | Loading, scheduling and connections together |
| Pipelines tab | Status and run history for all scheduled work |
| Connections tab | All external connections |
| CLI | `bq ls --transfer_config` and `bq ls --connection` |
